newsitem.title: MEXICO: Ahmsa, Inland Steel to bid jointly on Sidor.
newsitem.headline: Ahmsa, Inland Steel to bid jointly on Sidor.

text.p: Mexico's Grupo Acerero del Norte (GAN), the holding company for steel giant Altos Hornos de Mexico (Ahmsa), said on Wednesday that GAN and Ahmsa would be joined by U.S.-based Inland Steel Industries in bidding on Venezuela's state-owned Siderurgica del Orinoco (Sidor).

"The association with Inland provides additional synergies to Ahmsa-GAN in the process of buying Sidor, at the same time offering both the opportunity to expand their markets with greater production capacity, quality and mix of finished products," GAN said in a statement.

The statement said the Venezuelan government has approved Ahmsa-GAN as a qualified bidder for Sidor, which has a capacity of 1.8 million tonnes a year and is considered Latin America's last remaining state-owned steel company.
Ten other companies from Brazil, Japan, South Korea, Argentina and Venezuela have qualified to bid on Sidor, although the privatization still needs approval from the Venezuelan Congress.
Ahmsa and Inland steel have been partners since 1994 in Ryerson de Mexico, a company that operates a distribution and service network for steel and other metal products.
